title: File upstream prime-agent bug: terminated provider stream hangs --autonomous runs forever
description: Field-verified 4x in one production epic (2x opus-5, 2x sonnet-5; one died right after an issued toolCall). A terminated provider stream in an --autonomous run neither retries nor exits — the process idles forever with no report. Detection: session .jsonl mtime frozen >15min, no child processes, transcript tail shows stopReason:error/'terminated' or dangling toolCall. Expected: autonomous mode should treat a terminated stream as retry-or-exit, never idle. Also worth reporting: -r <session-id> does not resolve sessions under a custom --session-dir. Full retro evidence: /tmp/tys-retro.md (epic tys). File against PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
acceptance_criteria: Upstream issue filed with the detection signature and reproduction context; issue link recorded in a note here
